recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7824 unless a future pharmacy or v2 mapping review changes MedicationAdministration.device mapping semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-7824 was a Published/Persuasive pharmacy change request from the 2015 May cycle asking to add RXR-3 Administrative Device to the MedicationAdministration.device v2 mapping, changing the existing PRT-10 Participation Device mapping to include both PRT-10 and RXR-3.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 651364cb098a623c36afc1d6b9d56578507d897c, a 2015 v2 mapping update batch whose subject explicitly included tracker 7824 and whose patch changed MedicationAdministration.device from PRT-10 only to PRT-10 Participation Device / RXR-3 Administrative Device in the then-authoritative MedicationAdministration spreadsheet source.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. A 2021 source rework carried the mapping forward into source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct discussion that conflicted with the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current build-scope StructureDefinition already says PRT-10 Participation Device / RXR-3 Administrative Device for MedicationAdministration.device, so editing source would be redundant.
